idea: Resume and LinkedIn review for final-year engineering students before placements

strategist.problem: Final-year engineering students in India panic 2 weeks before campus placement drives when they realize their resume lacks ATS keywords and their LinkedIn profile looks inactive, but they cannot afford ₹5,000+ career coaches and don't know which specific lines to fix to pass the HR screen.
strategist.target_customer: Final-year B.Tech/M.Tech students at Tier-2 and Tier-3 engineering colleges in India who are actively applying to 10+ companies via campus portals and LinkedIn, and who have already spent money on mock tests or interview prep, showing willingness to pay for placement-specific outcomes.
strategist.mission: We provide a 48-hour, line-by-line resume and LinkedIn audit for final-year engineering students, delivered via WhatsApp, to ensure their profile passes the initial HR screen before the placement drive begins.

competitors.name: Local career coaching centers in Tier-2 cities
competitors.differentiator: They charge ₹3,000-₹10,000 for generic 2-hour workshops; we offer a personalized, asynchronous 48-hour review for a fraction of that cost without requiring travel to a physical center.

competitors.name: Freelance resume writers on Fiverr/Upwork
competitors.differentiator: They are global, slow (3-5 days), and often lack context on Indian campus placement ATS quirks; we are local, fast (48 hours), and specifically tuned to Indian engineering placement keywords and HR expectations.

competitors.name: AI resume builder tools (e.g., Teal, Rezi)
competitors.differentiator: They are self-serve and require the student to interpret generic advice; we provide a human-in-the-loop, done-for-you review that tells the student exactly what to change and why, removing the cognitive load during a high-stress period.

scope_cuts: No custom web app or SaaS dashboard: We deliver reviews via WhatsApp and Google Docs to avoid engineering overhead, allowing the founder to focus on the service quality and student acquisition rather than building and maintaining software infrastructure.

No LinkedIn content creation or ghostwriting: We only review and optimize the existing profile structure and keywords; we do not post content for the student, which keeps the service scope tight and the turnaround time under 48 hours.

No interview preparation or mock interviews: We strictly limit the offering to resume and LinkedIn profile optimization; adding interview prep would dilute the brand promise, increase delivery time, and require the founder to become an interview coach, which is outside the core 'profile audit' value proposition.

first_10_steps: Pick one niche tonight: final-year students at 2 Tier-2/Tier-3 engineering colleges whose placement drive starts in the next 6 weeks — write the college names down in Google Sheets

Open a Google Drive folder and build 1 anonymised sample audit: take a weak engineering resume, run it through Claude, and produce a before/after Google Doc with 15 line-level fixes and a LinkedIn headline rewrite
Build the Carrd one-page site in one sitting: offer, 48-hour promise, sample before/after, 3 WhatsApp contact buttons, Razorpay payment link
Create the Razorpay payment link for the Complete Placement Pack and test it with a ₹1 UPI payment to yourself
Write the 3-message WhatsApp Business sequence: (1) free 3-line resume verdict, (2) offer + link, (3) 48-hour delivery promise + FAQ
Recruit 5 discounted pilots: DM 30 batchmates and 2 college WhatsApp groups with the free 3-line verdict hook; first 5 get the launch price in exchange for a testimonial
Set up a Google Sheet tracker with columns: name, college, paid ₹, received date, delivered date, testimonial status — log every lead
Record a 45-second Instagram Reel on a phone showing a real before/after resume line (blurred names) using VN Video Editor, post with WhatsApp link in bio
Ask 2 batchmates to each refer 1 paying student this week in exchange for a ₹ referral cut — note their names in the tracker
Deliver the first pilot within 48 hours of payment, ask for a 3-line WhatsApp testimonial, and paste it onto the Carrd page the same day

revenue_targets.notes: 5 discounted pilots at 999 INR each. Break-even reached (5 customers > 4.05 threshold).
8 total customers. 3 new at full price, 5 pilots retained. Capacity: 8 clients x ~1.5h = 12h/week, fits within 15h/week.
11 total customers. 3 new at full price, 8 existing retained. Capacity: 11 clients x ~1.5h = ~16.5h/week, at the ceiling of the 15h/week budget, so 11 is the hard cap without hiring.

key_assumptions: Students will pay 999 INR one-time for a 48-hour human-in-the-loop review, as it is significantly cheaper than the 3000-10000 INR local career coaching centers.

Delivery cost per customer (100 INR) is cash-only (data/phone/Razorpay fee buffer); the founder's ~1.5 hours per client is unpaid opportunity cost, which is why targets are capped at 11 customers by Day 90 to fit the 15 hours/week constraint.
The 48-hour turnaround and WhatsApp delivery format will convert leads at a rate sufficient to reach 5 paying customers within the first 30 days of launch.
The 2% + GST Razorpay fee is absorbed into the delivery cost and does not require a separate line item in the monthly burn calculation.

channels.name: Campus WhatsApp groups + hostel/class broadcast (primary channel)
channels.tactic: Join 30 final-year placement WhatsApp groups across Tier-2/Tier-3 colleges (class groups, T&P cell groups, hostel batches). Post 1 message/day in each group at 9 PM: a free 3-line ATS sample review of a public resume with the hook 'DM me your resume, free 3-line ATS scan in 24h'. Reply personally to every 'how' within 10 minutes. Run a refer-a-batchmate loop: pay ₹999, get ₹200 UPI back for every batchmate who pays (reward, not spend). Target 15 personal WhatsApp conversations/day, 4-5 paid in the month.

channels.name: Instagram Reels + small LinkedIn DM follow-up (secondary channel)
channels.tactic: Post 1 Instagram Reel/day (CapCut + ChatGPT script) showing a real before/after bullet rewrite with ATS keywords hidden, caption 'Comment ATS for a free 3-line scan'. Reply to every comment/DM within 30 minutes and move the conversation to WhatsApp. Additionally DM 8 final-year students/day on LinkedIn (filter: batch 2025, Tier-2/3 colleges, 'open to work') with the 3-line cold message — capped at 8/day so it stays sustainable alongside delivery. Budget ₹2,000/month = ₹1,000 Instagram Boost on top 6 Reels + ₹1,000 Canva Pro. Target 2 paid in the month.

first_10_customers: Week 1: Ask 3 batchmates in your own T&P WhatsApp group for their resume; do 3 full audits free (48h, Google Doc + WhatsApp) and ask each for a 2-line WhatsApp testimonial + permission to forward the doc. These 3 become your proof.

Week 1-2: Post the anonymised before/after of one free audit as an Instagram Reel and a LinkedIn post; reply to every comment with the free 3-line scan offer. DM 8 final-year students/day on LinkedIn with the cold message.

Week 2: Offer 5 'pilot' slots at ₹999 to the first 5 who reply, framed as 'founding price, 48h delivery, full refund if the fix list doesn't help you rewrite 5+ bullets'. Collect via Razorpay payment link or UPI.
Week 3: In every delivered Google Doc, add a last line: 'If 2 of your batchmates buy, your next refresh is free' — this is the referral loop that carries you from 5 to 10.

Week 3-4: Message 5 college T&P coordinators / placement club leads you know personally on WhatsApp; offer 1 free audit for the club to share as a 'placement prep' resource in their official group in exchange for a group post.

Week 4: Follow up personally on WhatsApp with everyone who asked 'price kya hai' but didn't pay — send the Razorpay link again with 'pilot price valid till Sunday'. 2 of your first 10 will come from this list.
growth.cold_message: Hi [name], saw you're final-year at [college] and applying to placements — most resumes I scan fail the ATS screen on 3-4 fixable lines (weak verbs, missing keywords like 'DSA', 'REST API'). Send me your resume and I'll reply with a free 3-line ATS scan in 24 hours, no strings. If the fixes look useful, my full 48-hour line-by-line audit is ₹999.

objections.objection: ₹999 is too much, I can just use ChatGPT for free
objections.response: You can — but ChatGPT gives generic advice and won't know that TCS/Infosys screening filters look for 'REST API', 'SDLC', 'stakeholder' in your exact bullet format. My ₹999 audit is a human-checked, line-by-line rewrite against Indian campus ATS patterns, delivered in 48 hours with a fix list ordered by impact. If I don't rewrite at least 5 bullets you'd actually use, I refund the ₹999.

objections.objection: I'll do it later, placement season is still 3 weeks away
objections.response: HR screens open the week drives are announced, not the week of the drive — and the top 200 resumes get shortlisted before you even hear back. Send me your resume today for a free 3-line scan; if it already passes, I'll tell you that honestly and you've lost nothing.

critic.verdict: The plan is a coherent, well-scoped service business that stays true to the startup idea: a 48-hour human-in-the-loop resume and LinkedIn audit for final-year Indian engineering students, delivered via WhatsApp at ₹499-₹999, which fits the bootstrapped student-founder constraints and campus-first channel. Pricing, tools and burn are realistic and the growth playbook is concrete enough to start within an hour. The main weakness is that delivery cost per customer (₹100) understates the real work — the founder's ~1.5 hours per client is the actual cost, and at 11 clients/week the plan already exceeds the 15-hour cap once free 3-line scans and DMs are counted.
critic.biggest_risk: Demand generation: the plan assumes the founder can convert cold WhatsApp/Instagram/LinkedIn outreach into 5 paying customers in 30 days with zero prior brand or track record, but free 3-line scans and DMs typically produce very low paid conversion in the first month, risking a stalled pipeline before any testimonial proof exists.
